subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned files outside the session workspace, or should external entries stay behind fs-safe containment as hidden or neutral rows?
rationale: The PR fixes a confusing Missing badge by raw-statting outside-root paths, which changes the read-scoped Gateway file boundary and needs maintainer security/product intent before implementation can be considered correct.

options.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Preserve workspace containment and solve the UI confusion by filtering external rows or representing them without outside-root filesystem metadata.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external file metadata only with explicit security acceptance plus tests for absolute paths, symlink escapes, and content-denial behavior.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Rely on the merged current-main layout fix and handle the external/directory Missing behavior in the canonical issue after deciding the backend contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Preserve workspace containment and solve the UI confusion by filtering external rows or representing them without outside-root filesystem metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work on workspace file previews and containment makes this the closest current owner for the security-boundary choice.
